reason: 该插件的主要用途是会话内自动化：用户在 dsh-TUI 中通过 `/cron` 定义 5 段 cron 任务，到点后按计划将预设提示词作为下一条 follow-up 用户消息发送，此外它提供任务面板与启停/删除操作，并将任务配置本地化保存。

summaries.zh: dsh-TUI 定时插件可通过 /cron 记录 5 字段 cron 表达式与提示词，在到点时把对应提示词作为下一轮用户 follow-up 消息发送，用于会话内定时提醒与自动化执行。
summaries.en: A dsh-TUI plugin that lets you define 5-field cron rules with /cron and send the configured prompt as the next follow-up user message when each schedule is due.

capabilities: Follow-up prompt injection into live conversation turns
Local JSON-backed job persistence and basic task control (add/remove/toggle)

reasons.code: README states `/cron` saves a 5-field cron schedule and prompt and fires it as a follow-up user message in the current session.
README documents scheduler runtime dependency on the active dsh profile process, with missed offline triggers not replayed.
README describes task data stored in `~/.dsh-tui/cron.json` as plain JSON fields including id/cron/prompt/enabled timestamps.

capabilities: Follow-up prompt injection into live conversation turns
Local JSON-backed job persistence and basic task control (add/remove/toggle)
